project.title: Db2 LockLens - Explainable Database Lock & Deadlock Investigator
project.short_description: An IBM Db2 observability dashboard that uses native lock monitoring to identify blocking and waiting applications, explain lock contention with evidence-based diagnostics, recommend safe next steps, and persist incident history in Db2.

features_used: Unique index excluding NULL keys (incident de-duplication)

ai_models: None required; optional local Ollama model through LangChain
